<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Returned items for exchange"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Delivery"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_User" name="User" processRef="Process_User"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shop" name="Online shop" processRef="Process_Shop"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Event_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Returned items for exchange" sourceRef="Event_ReturnSent" targetRef="Start_ReturnReceived" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Delivery" sourceRef="Event_DeliverySent" targetRef="Event_DeliveryReceived" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_User" name="Purchase items from an online shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_User">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_User" name="User">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_User</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseReward</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPaymentMethod</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Pay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InstallmentAgreement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OrderSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_DeliveryReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReturnChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ReturnSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ExchangeDeliveryReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_PurchaseComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_User" name="Start order"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to account"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Select items and set payment method"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose free reward"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentChoice" name="Choose payment option"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InstallmentAgreement" name="Complete installment agreement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Merge payment options"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Items, reward, and payment ready"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderSubmitted" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeliveryReceived" name="Items delivered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliveryReceived" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReturnChoice" name="Return items for exchange?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_ReturnSent" name="Returned items sent">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReturnSent" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExchangeDeliveryReceived" name="Exchange items delivered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExchangeDeliveryReceived" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PurchaseComplete" name="Purchase complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_01" sourceRef="Start_User" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_02" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_04" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_05" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_06" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_07" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_08" name="Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_09" name="Complete installment agreement" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_InstallmentAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_10" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_11" sourceRef="Task_InstallmentAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_12" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Event_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_14" sourceRef="Event_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="Event_DeliveryReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_15" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_16" name="Return for exchange" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_17" name="Do not return" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice" targetRef="End_PurchaseComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_18" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Event_ReturnSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_19" sourceRef="Event_ReturnSent" targetRef="Event_ExchangeDeliveryReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_20" sourceRef="Event_ExchangeDeliveryReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shop" name="Deliver items" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shop">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Shop" name="Online shop">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ReturnReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_DeliverySent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_DeliveryComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReturnReceived" name="Returned items received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReturnReceived" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DeliveryMerge" name="Merge delivery requests"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_DeliverySent" name="Items delivered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliverySent" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DeliveryComplete" name="Delivery complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_01" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_02" sourceRef="Start_ReturnReceived" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_03" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryMerge" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_04" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Event_DeliverySent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_05" sourceRef="Event_DeliverySent" targetRef="End_DeliveryComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
